PromptNotFound.title: Batch Contains Invalid Items
PromptNotFound.message: One or more prompts in the batch do not exist or have been archived.
PromptNotFound.suggestion: Use the validation tool to check each item before retrying. Remove invalid items and purchase the rest.

AlreadyPurchased.title: Batch Contains Invalid Items
AlreadyPurchased.message: You have already purchased one of these prompts. You cannot buy the same prompt twice.
AlreadyPurchased.suggestion: Use the validation tool to check each item before retrying. Remove invalid items and purchase the rest.

CreatorCannotBuy.title: Purchase Failed
CreatorCannotBuy.message: You cannot purchase prompts you created. Try a different batch.
CreatorCannotBuy.suggestion: Try again with a smaller batch or individual purchases. Contact support if the problem persists.

PromptInactive.title: Purchase Failed
PromptInactive.message: One or more prompts are no longer for sale. Check their status and try again.
PromptInactive.suggestion: Try again with a smaller batch or individual purchases. Contact support if the problem persists.

InvalidPaymentAmount.title: Payment Mismatch
InvalidPaymentAmount.message: The payment for one or more prompts is insufficient. Recalculate prices and retry.
InvalidPaymentAmount.suggestion: Ensure each prompt price is paid in full. Recalculate totals and retry.

ListingExpired.title: Purchase Failed
ListingExpired.message: One or more prompts have reached their expiration date and are no longer available.
ListingExpired.suggestion: Try again with a smaller batch or individual purchases. Contact support if the problem persists.

ContractIsPaused.title: Marketplace Temporarily Paused
ContractIsPaused.message: The marketplace is temporarily paused. Please try again later.
ContractIsPaused.suggestion: Check back in a few moments and try again.

BulkPurchaseTooLarge.title: Batch Too Large
BulkPurchaseTooLarge.message: Your batch size exceeds the maximum allowed (20 prompts per transaction). Split into smaller batches.
BulkPurchaseTooLarge.suggestion: Try purchasing in groups of 10-15 prompts per transaction for better success rates.

DuplicatePromptId.title: Purchase Failed
DuplicatePromptId.message: The same prompt ID appears multiple times in the batch. Remove duplicates and retry.
DuplicatePromptId.suggestion: Try again with a smaller batch or individual purchases. Contact support if the problem persists.

InvalidPrice.title: Payment Mismatch
InvalidPrice.message: The number of payment amounts does not match the number of prompts. Both lists must be equal length.
InvalidPrice.suggestion: Ensure each prompt price is paid in full. Recalculate totals and retry.

ArithmeticOverflow.title: Purchase Failed
ArithmeticOverflow.message: One or more prices are too large to process. Contact support if this persists.
ArithmeticOverflow.suggestion: Try again with a smaller batch or individual purchases. Contact support if the problem persists.
